weak.notes: Typical one-shot plan: feature names without behavior, no fields, no states, TBD/TODO placeholders, and scope creep ('iCloud sync later') that contradicts 'no cloud'. Edit/delete, over-budget warning, and on-device-only constraint are not addressed.

medium.notes: Correct template and full requirement list, but thin: only an empty state for one screen, generic error handling, no migration plan, no file tree, 3 acceptance criteria. Used as the worked example in docs/evaluation-system-v0.1.md.

strong.notes: Everything specified: fields and types, migration plan, every screen with loading/empty/error states, validation table, file tree with checked build steps, 8 Given/When/Then acceptance criteria mapped to R-ids.
